result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and pedestrian signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide roadway lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance without a refuge island or curb extensions.
hazards.location_in_image: The span of the roadway between sidewalks

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. The roadway includes trolley tracks and is controlled by a traffic signal, though dedicated pedestrian signals are not clearly visible.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the asphalt can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians or a risk for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running parallel to traffic

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the crosswalk limit the visibility between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection corners

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features sidewalks on both sides of a two-lane street with mixed-use buildings. Safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings, a lack of visible pedestrian signals, and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner obstruct the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized urban intersection with sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The environment is characterized by mixed-use brick buildings and integrated trolley tracks within the roadway.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal rails in the roadway can be slippery and pose a tripping hazard or a risk to cyclists.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing
hazards.description: The distance across the street increases exposure time for pedestrians in the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder patterns for better visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
